name: brain-access
title: Check Authorized Brain Remote Access
description: Checks one explicitly supplied Brain endpoint from the machine running Magic Box. It tests unauthenticated access first and can retry with a credential loaded from an environment variable, without returning Brain content.

settings.name: url
settings.title: Brain URL
settings.description: One explicit authorized Brain HTTP(S) endpoint. This Tool does not guess or enumerate Brain paths.

settings.name: authorized_target
settings.title: Authorized Target
settings.description: Confirm this target is yours or you are permitted to test.

settings.name: auth_env
settings.title: Credential Environment Variable
settings.description: Optional environment-variable name containing the credential. Never put the credential itself here.

settings.name: auth_header
settings.title: Auth Header
settings.description: Optional HTTP header name. Defaults to Authorization.

settings.name: auth_scheme
settings.title: Auth Scheme
settings.description: Optional prefix such as Bearer. Defaults to Bearer.

settings.name: auth_raw
settings.title: Raw Credential Header
settings.description: When true, sends the environment credential as the complete header value with no Bearer or other scheme prefix.

settings.name: marker
settings.title: Known Marker
settings.description: Optional non-secret marker expected in the authorized Brain response. The response body is never returned.

settings.name: expect_boundary
settings.title: Expected Brain Boundary
settings.description: Optional expected boundary classification, such as protected-and-accessible or exposed-without-auth.

settings.name: expect_marker
settings.title: Expected Marker Result
settings.description: Optional assertion for whether the authenticated Brain response should contain the supplied marker.

settings.name: timeout_ms
settings.title: Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Optional request timeout from 250 to 15000 milliseconds.
